description: A pull request of Renovate's merges itself, on a run of Renovate that finds every check green, unless a rule below says otherwise; platformAutomerge is off because Renovate promises that only of its own automerge. No merge cuts a release: the note each pull request carries goes under [Unreleased] and names no version, and the release workflow acts only on a version with no tag. constraints.golang is an exact version so that Renovate installs the Go that postUpgradeTasks need without looking its releases up on GitHub, which takes a token Renovate here does not have; it is go.mod's go directive. The note is in single quotes and has no backtick, which a shell would run.

packageRules.description: A major version is never merged by Renovate, whatever the checks say: the rules below keep out the ones that are no update, and what is left is read

gc's pin is read, not merged: the checks do not run a city, and what changed upstream is read against the runtime protocol, the session's environment and the commands the work tools call (the owner, 2026-11-16)
The Go directive is the Dockerfile's Go as well: they move together, by hand

The changelog tool that postUpgradeTasks runs is a tool of go.mod. Its move is a pull request of its own with no note, and merges itself on green checks like the others, though no check runs the tool.
connect-go v2 is a new module path, connectrpc.com/connect/v2, and the move to it is work of its own; a bare require of the new major, which nothing imports, is no update

goldmark v2 is a new module path, github.com/yuin/goldmark/v2, with a new design (generics, a parser and a renderer apart, a different AST) that its own README calls early: v1 is kept up with fixes for a major version back. The page of transcripts renders agents' Markdown with raw HTML dropped and a link to a script removed, and the example's test walks headings with the parser: the move is a rewrite of both and a check of what the page escapes, work of its own; a bare require of the new major, which nothing imports, is no update
acp-go 0.4.0 does not build with claudeacp 0.6.0 (Diff.OldText is a pointer, Nullable), and the library is to be replaced (spec-bb1.38): no updates of it until then; this rule goes with that ticket
